> '$REMOTE/gate-b-qwen3-crashdiag.pid'" || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:$PORT tcp:$PORT >/dev/null; READY=0; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then READY=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; echo server_health_ready=$READY; test "$READY" = 1; PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat "$REMOTE/gate-b-qwen3-crashdiag.pid" | tr -d ''); echo qwen3_pid=$PID; echo '--- status before inference ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "cat /proc/$PID/status 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(VmPeak|VmSize|VmHWM|VmRSS|RssAnon|RssFile|VmSwap|Threads):'" || true; echo '--- mem before inference ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "grep -E '^(MemFree|MemAvailable|SwapFree):' /proc/meminfo"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import json; s=json.load(open("benchmarks/text_model_suite_v1.json",encoding="utf-8")); json.dump({"model":"qwen3-phone-4b-2507","stream":False,"temperature":0.0,"seed":42,"max_tokens":96,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":s["system_prompt"]},{"role":"user","content":s["warmup_prompt"]}]},open("/tmp/qwen3-request.json","w",encoding="utf-8"),ensure_ascii=False)'; set +e; CURL_OUT=$(curl -sS --max-time 180 -w '
CURL_HTTP=%{http_code} CURL_TIME=%{time_total}
' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @/tmp/qwen3-request.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/chat/completions 2>&1); CURL_RC=$?; set -e; echo gate_b_qwen3_first_request_rc=$CURL_RC; printf '%s
' "$CURL_OUT" | tail -40; sleep 2; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "test -d /proc/$PID"; then echo qwen3_alive_after_request=true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "cat /proc/$PID/status 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(VmPeak|VmSize|VmHWM|VmRSS|RssAnon|RssFile|VmSwap|Threads):'" || true; else echo qwen3_alive_after_request=false; fi; echo '--- mem after request ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "grep -E '^(MemFree|MemAvailable|SwapFree):' /proc/meminfo"; echo '--- server log tail ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell tail -200 "$REMOTE/gate-b-qwen3-crashdiag.log" || true; echo '--- lmk/oom logcat tail ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "logcat -d -v brief -T 15m 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'lmkd|lowmemory|out of memory|oom|killing.*llama|kill.*llama|memory pressure' | tail -120" || true; echo '--- kernel memory hints ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'oom|out of memory|killed process|lowmemory|llama' | tail -80" || true; BAT2=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys battery | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*temperature: *//p' | head -1 | tr -d '' || true); echo battery_temp_tenths_c_after=${BAT2:-unknown}; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); test -z "$HELPER"; git push origin --delete tmp-noop-check agent-control-checkpoint-unused >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo gate_b_qwen3_crash_diagnostic_complete=true
